INFISICAL_TOKEN.description: Infisical static access token (machine identity Token Auth). Omit or set to 'mock' to use the mock client (e.g. in tests or when the integration is disabled). Not needed when INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID and INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET are set.

INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID.description: Infisical machine identity Universal Auth client id. With INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET, used instead of INFISICAL_TOKEN.

INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Infisical machine identity Universal Auth client secret. Used with INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID.

INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID.description: Infisical project ID. Required for live API calls (e.g. getSecret); not needed when using the mock client.

INFISICAL_ENVIRONMENT.description: Infisical environment slug (e.g. dev, staging, prod). Required for live API calls (e.g. getSecret); not needed when using the mock client.
